value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for 1 year (walking) to 3 years with a parent - their site says, though I could not pin down the day, time or price from their term PDF. They also run Rock n' Roll with Miss Kelly for 0+ with a parent. Both need registering via their Uplifter site. I'll keep watching and text you when I can get to them.
